summary: SUB-02 decide: no silent remote fallback for local System One decisions

delivery.outcome: POST /v1/decide and /v1/system-one/decide no longer send decision state to a cloud route when the local System One model fails or Ollama is unavailable: without allow_remote_fallback: true the proxy answers 503 LOCAL_DECISION_UNAVAILABLE (reason, provider: null, X-Subactor-Remote-Fallback: refused) with zero provider attempts. A request without application headers is attributed to subactor-proxy/decide, not heyasa/command, and needs declared headers or an explicit route to fall back remotely. Explicitly requested registered routes are unchanged.
nonGoals: SUB-03 local timeout and keep_alive are not changed.

architecture.decision: Gate the remote fallback branch of _handle_system_one_decide on an explicit boolean allow_remote_fallback and on a declared application route.

validation.evidence: all pass, including the Ollama 500 variants
